tf={'id':lambda g:g,'r180':lambda g:g[::-1,::-1],'fH':lambda g:g[:,::-1],'fV':lambda g:g[::-1,:]}

def solve(I,O,verbose=False):
    I=np.array(I); O=np.array(O)
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I==6)
    out=[]
    for k in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==k)
        r0,r1=ys.min(),ys.max(); c0,c1=xs.min(),xs.max()
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        g=O[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
        # full-grid pool under any transform, score by manh dist between block centers
        pool=[]
        for R in range(I.shape[0]-h+1):
            for C in range(I.shape[1]-w+1):
                blk=I[R:R+h,C:C+w]
                if (blk==6).any(): continue
                for tn,T in tf.items():
                    if (T(blk)==g).all():
                        dr=abs(R+(h-1)/2-(r0+r1)/2)+abs(C+(w-1)/2-(c0+c1)/2)

        pool.sort(key=lambda p:p[0])
        best=min(pool)
        out.append(best)
        if verbose: print(k,(r0,c0),(h,w),'fill center',(r0+c1//2),(r1//2,c1//2),best)
    return out

import numpy as np, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from scipy import ndimage
tf={'id':lambda g:g,'r180':lambda g:g[::-1,::-1],'fH':lambda g:g[:,::-1],'fV':lambda g:g[::-1,:]}

def solve(I,O,verbose=False):
    I=np.array(I); O=np.array(O)
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I==6)
    picks=[]
    for k in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==k)
        r0,r1=ys.min(),ys.max(); c0,c1=xs.min(),xs.max()
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        gc=(r0+r1)/2-(h-1)/2; gc2=(c0+c1)/2-(w-1)/2
        pool=[]
        for R in range(I.shape[0]-h+1):
            for C in range(I.shape[1]-w+1):
                blk=I[R:R+h,C:C+w]
                if (blk==6).any(): continue
                for tn,T in tf.items():
                    Tb=T(blk)
                    if Tb.size!=h*w: continue
                    pool.append((abs(R+(h-1)/2-gc)+abs(C+(w-1)/2-gc2), int(R), int(C), tn, Tb.copy()))
        pool.sort(key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1],p[2]))
        d,R,C,tn,Tb=pool[0]
        picks.append(((int(r0),int(c0)),(h,w),(R,C),tn,d))
        if verbose: print(k,(int(r0),int(c0)),(h,w),'-> d=%.2f pos=%s tn=%s'%(d,(R,C),tn))
    return picks
for dk in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    picks=solve(G[dk+' input'],G[dk+' output'],verbose=True)
    # reconstruct & verify
    I=np.array(G[dk+' input']); pred=I.copy()
    for (comp,tshape,pos,tn,d) in picks:
        r0,c0=comp; h,w=tshape
        blk=I[pos[0]:pos[0]+h,pos[1]:pos[1]+w]
        for tn2,T in tf.items():
            if tn2==tn: Tb=T(blk); break
        pred[r0:r0+h,c0:c0+w]=Tb
    print(dk,'reconstruct match:', np.array_equal(pred,np.array(G[dk+' output'])))

import numpy as np, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def T8(a):
    return {'id':a.copy(),'h':a[:,::-1],'v':a[::-1,:],'hv':a[::-1,::-1],
            'T':np.rot90(a),'hd':np.rot90(np.rot90(a)),
            'va':np.rot90(a,2),'x':np.rot90(np.rot90(np.rot90(a)))}
for pn in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=np.array(G[pn+' input']); O=np.array(G[pn+' output'])
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I==6)
    print('===',pn,'comps:',n)
    for ka in range(1,n+1):
        y,x=np.where(lab==ka)
        r0,r1,c0,c1=int(y.min()),int(y.max()),int(x.min()),int(x.max())
        tgt=O[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]; h,w=tgt.shape

        hits_exact=[(rn,cn) for rn in range(I.shape[0]-h+1) for cn in range(I.shape[1]-w+1) if (I[rn:rn+h,cn:cn+w]==tgt).all()]
        # B: subgrid has no 6s and non-6 pattern matches tgt pattern
        hits_pat=[]
        mask=(tgt==6)
        for rn in range(I.shape[0]-h+1):

import numpy as np, re, os
from scipy import ndimage
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def T8(a):
    return {'id':a.copy(),'h':a[:,::-1],'v':a[::-1,:],'hv':a[::-1,::-1],
            'T':np.rot90(a),'hd':np.rot90(np.rot90(a)),
            'va':np.rot90(a,2),'x':np.rot90(a,3)}
for pn in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=np.array(G[pn+' input']); O=np.array(G[pn+' output'])
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I==6)
    ok_all=True
    for ka in range(1,n+1):
        y,x=np.where(lab==ka)
        r0,r1=int(y.min()),int(y.max()); c0,c1=int(x.min()),int(x.max())
        tgt=O[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]; h,w=tgt.shape
        # pool: all clean windows (no 6s) with any 8-dihedral transform equal to tgt
        pool=[]
        seen=set()
        for op,t in T8(I).items():
            if t.shape!=tgt.shape: continue
            hh,ww=t.shape
            for rn in range(I.shape[0]-hh+1):
                for cn in range(I.shape[1]-ww+1):
                    key=(rn,cn,tuple(t.flatten()))
                    if key in seen: continue
                    seen.add(key)
                    if (I[rn:rn+hh,cn:cn+ww]==t).all():
                        dv=max(0,r0-rn,rr:=rn+hh-(r1+1)) if False else max(0,r0-rn,max(0,rn+hh-(r1+1)))
                        dh=max(0,c0-cn,max(0,cn+ww-(c1+1)))
                        pool.append((dv,dh,op,(rn,cn)))
        pool.sort(key=lambda p:p[:2])
        pred=None
        # try each candidate, apply to I, compare
        for dv,dh,op,pos in pool:
            tt=T8(I)[op]
            J=I.copy(); J[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]=tt
            if (J==O).all(): pred=pos; break
        status='MATCH' if pred else 'FAIL'
        print(pn,'comp',ka,'shape',(h,w),'cands',len(pool),'->',status, pred)
        ok_all &= status=='MATCH'
    print(pn,'ALL OK' if ok_all else 'not yet')

import numpy as np
def T_preserve_shape(a):
    # all 8 dihedral ops keeping exact shape; for square: all 8; else the 2 flips
    outs=[a.copy(), np.fliplr(a)]

from scipy import ndimage
def dihs(a):
    seen=set(); outs=[]
    for fl in range(2):
        b=np.fliplr(a) if fl else a
        for k_ in range(4):
            o=np.rot90(b,k_)
            key=o.tobytes()
            if key not in seen: seen.add(key); outs.append(o)
    return outs
# Nearest-clean-window rule by manhattan center distance, transform = first matching dihedral scan order. Validate on demos 1-3 fully; check demo4 failure case details separately.
for pn in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I=np.array(G[pn+' input']); O=np.array(G[pn+' output']); H,W=I.shape
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I==6)
    tot=0
    for ka in range(1,n+1):
        y,x=np.where(lab==ka)
        rr0,cc0=int(y.min()),int(x.min())
        th,tw=y.max()-rr0+1,x.max()-cc0+1
        cr=(rr0+y.max()+1)/2; cl=(cc0+x.max()+1)/2
        hits=[]
        for rr in range(H-th+1):
            for cc in range(W-tw+1):
                blk=I[rr:rr+th,cc:cc+tw]
                if (blk==6).any(): continue
                for oi,t_ in enumerate(dihs(blk)):
                    md=abs(rr-cr)+abs(cc-cl)
                    hits.append((md,(rr,cc),oi))
        hits.sort()
        pred=dihs(I[hits[0][1][0]:hits[0][1][0]+th,hits[0][1][1]:hits[0][1][1]+tw])[hits[0][2]]
        ok=np.array_equal(pred,O[rr0:rr0+th,cc0:cc0+tw]); tot+=ok
        print(' ',pn,'comp',ka,'nhits',len(hits),'ok' if ok else 'FAIL')
    print(pn,'total',tot,'/',n)
